title: Bollywood Diwali Nights NYC | New York’s Desi Diwali Party
description: Celebrate Diwali in New York City with Bollywood, Punjabi and global club sounds, festive fashion and nonstop dancing on Saturday, November

Celebrate Diwali in New York City with Bollywood, Punjabi and global club sounds, festive fashion and nonstop dancing on Saturday, November

About this Event

🗽 BOLLYWOOD DIWALI NIGHTS AT HARBOR NYC 🗽
New York City, get ready for an unforgettable Diwali celebration! On Saturday, November 7, brings Bollywood Diwali Nights to Harbor NYC for an elevated night of music, culture, fashion and nonstop Desi energy.
🎧 Featuring 
DJ Chandani will set the dance floor on fire with an electric mix of Bollywood chart-toppers, Punjabi bangers, iconic Desi throwbacks, trending remixes and global club sounds.
🥁 Plus Live Dholi
Feel the energy of live dhol beats throughout the night, bringing the sound and spirit of a true Indian celebration to the heart of New York City.
From the first beat to the final song, expect an energetic crowd, a packed dance floor and the unmatched nightlife atmosphere that only NYC can deliver.
Gather your friends, wear your best festive-meets-nightlife look and prepare for one of New York City’s most exciting Bollywood Diwali parties.
✨ WHAT TO EXPECT
• A special set by DJ Chandani
• High-energy live dhol performance
• Bollywood anthems and Punjabi party hits
• Desi throwbacks and trending club remixes
• A stylish Diwali-inspired nightlife experience
• NYC’s vibrant South Asian crowd
• Festive fashion and unforgettable photo moments
• Premium VIP table experience
📍 VENUE
Harbor NYC
621 W 46th St, New York, NY 10036
